name: Ferienwohnung Buchauer
beschreibung:
Scenic and sunny in Ebbs, Ferienwohnung Buchauer provides comfortable living spaces with panoramic views over the Zahmer Kaiser peaks. The well-equipped apartment features separate bedrooms, a full kitchen, and a private balcony.

Highlights such as the Fohlenhof stud farm, trails into the Kaiser valley, and the Hallo du leisure centre are all quickly reached.
kurzbeschreibung: Ferienwohnung Buchauer in Ebbs offers sunny relaxation and spacious accommodations for families in Kufsteinerland.
